facts.fact: 1. 治疗性开战：Kieran 要求 Rena 发火——With Oscar, you gave me hell for weeks（以前她会骂他几星期）；你恨 Zach 但几乎没见过他（= 你又在我身上预演）。
facts.anchor: I need you to be mad at me

facts.fact: 2. Rena 的起诉：You're playing with him——Oscar led on、Josiah 同样（let him think you were obsessed…right up until it bored you, and then? You just disappeared? Not so much as an apology?）。
facts.anchor: right up until it bored you

facts.fact: 3. 反转一：他爱过 Josiah（voice breaks）——ghost 了是真的、不骄傲，但再选一次还是会 ghost。
4. 原因：你以为多快有人能把地毯抽走？多会藏心事直到关键时——她 lurch back。
facts.anchor: pull the rug out from under you

facts.fact: 5. Josiah 夜真相：倒数第二晚——他朋友被送进机构（known practically from birth），突然她成了 'psycho'、被嫌弃 weak——如果被他发现我呢？刚开始好转、overnight 我看他的眼神变了——不是 bored，是 crushed。
6. 她先抱（hooking chin）：Rena, you don't ha——她更紧；他静下来接住（Tell me if it's too much）——something enormous carving a hole、Kieran-specific unbearable。
7. 错责互驳：Rena 崩溃（I thought it was my fault… I should have seen it）——Kieran 反抱窒息级：never your fault；他道歉（didn't really want it / didn't want to leave you）——I shut you out. I was just scared。

8. 收尾：You're the strongest person I know（'psycho' 事件的解毒）；lead shoes 脱掉（可能飘走）；And this wasn't even the code orange!（笑）；Lucas 今晚不动；I always need you——他 bereaved/guilty 一闪——I will always, always be here when you need me（solemn determination）。
